tools.name: site_info
tools.description: What Ace (ace-bl.tech) is, with links to its sitemap, docs, contact and every discovery document.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Find pages on ace-bl.tech by words in their URL path (sitemap search). Returns URLs with a match score.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read one https://ace-bl.tech page as Markdown (Cloudflare Markdown for Agents) or stripped text, up to 40,000 characters.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Everything an agent can buy from Ace, with Stripe-verified prices, billing terms, delivery and live availability.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a purchase of one offer. Returns a continue_url: send the buyer there to pay on the Stripe-hosted checkout page. This tool does not charge anything.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read a checkout started with create_checkout.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_pages · Private data: site_info · Public sink: create_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_pages · Private data: site_info · Public sink: create_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
